brief.text: Bambusa Therapeutics (BBTX) registered the single largest purchase at $46,639,957 from a 10% owner, while Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund (BPRE) led all cluster dollar totals with $37,168,650 across three buyers. Pharmaceutical names drew concentrated activity across both tables, anchored by Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP), where an unusually high group of seven insiders combined for $22,023,905. Additionally, Stewart Information Services (STC) stood out for insider breadth with five separate buyers aggregating $460,970, alongside Berkshire Hathaway's notable $26,894,245 transaction in Sirius XM Holdings (SIRI).
